 Beginning Jan. 1, Los Altos’ minimum wage will increase from $18.20 per hour to $19.25, excluding tips.  
 This increase applies to all Los Altos employees, adults and minors, who work more than two hours per week. Employees in Los Altos who are receiving less than wage are able to file against their employers through the City Manager’s Office.   
 “The City will investigate possible violations, will have access to payroll records, and will enforce violations of the minimum wage requirements by ordering reinstatement of employees, payment of back wages unlawfully withheld, and penalties,” according to the city’s website.  
 For more information, visit losaltosca.gov/511/Minimum-Wage .
